can: create project folders and notes inside one project root
record a deploy model the owner stated
inspect an existing git repository read-only
initialize an empty git repository where none exists (--init-git)
cannot: set CI secrets or install CI
commit, stage or branch in a repository

compatibility.adapters: must not change authority, permissions, data policy, or evidence

required: folder and artifact listing from the result

modes: invalid: rejected intake or boundary, nothing written
blocked: symlink, collision, file root or unreadable journal, nothing written
failed: write or git init error, progress kept in the journal
partial: unresolved deploy model, preserved conflicts or owner-owned git steps
failure.on_failure: report the tool's errors and gaps exactly; fix the cause and run resume; never delete owner files, links or repositories to pass
